description.value: The Nim Nim Interpretive Centre is a cultural gallery on K'ómoks First Nation territory near Courtenay on Vancouver Island, situated within the traditional lands of the K'ómoks and Pentlatch peoples. The K'ómoks First Nation has a deeply layered cultural heritage encompassing distinct origin stories, languages, and histories from several formerly separate tribes. A touring cyclist passing through the Comox Valley would find this a meaningful stop for Indigenous cultural education and interpretation.
